title: Give the name of the league had the most matches end as draw in the 2016 se
question:
Give the name of the league had the most matches end as draw in the 2016 season?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: most matches end as draw refers to MAX(SUM(home_team_goal = away_team_goal)); 2016 season refers to season = '2015/2016';

prediction.sql:
SELECT L.XCL_005
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.XCL_008 = L.XCL_003
WHERE M.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.XCL_003, L.XCL_005
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN M.XCL_015 = M.XCL_016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC
LIMIT 1;
